title: SciExam for ENSO: Can AI Agents Build Climate Models?
title_zh: SciExam for ENSO: 可以让 AI 代理构建气候模型吗?

paragraphs.en: Language-model agents are increasingly asked to carry out open-ended scientific research, yet their results are usually graded against a known answer, a rubric, or a language-model reviewer, none of which can tell whether a new scientific model is valid. The AI Science Exam for El Niño–Southern Oscillation ( SciExam for ENSO ) is a benchmark in which agents build low-order stochastic models of ENSO, the dominant mode of interannual climate variability, from real observations. Within a six-hour budget, agents process the observations, write their own diagnostics, which are then frozen, and develop a model using only these diagnostics as feedback. Hidden graders then test whether the model reproduces ENSO’s statistics, recovers unobserved variables, and forecasts held-out years, and score a published model in the same way. Across twelve agent systems, six produce models that score higher than the published model, mainly through better reconstruction and forecasting. The simplified forms of the stronger models are each compatible with one of the two competing explanations of ENSO’s warm–cold asymmetry, an open debate that the task never mentions. Controlled runs of the top system under varied information suggest that its scores do not come from recalling the dated observational record and that the information it receives shapes how it builds its model. SciExam for ENSO can thus evaluate agent research where no answer is known, and the results suggest that agents can already build competitive models whose structures bear on questions that scientists still debate.

paragraphs.en: Existing benchmarks grade agent results, whether answers or written reports, with unit tests or task-specific metrics [ 9 ] , rubrics derived from a known solution or target findings [ 26 , 33 ] , or language-model reviewers [ 17 ] . Open-ended research has no single correct answer against which its results can be scored. Dynamical modeling, in which proposed models are simulated and validated against observations, offers a natural testbed for open-ended research. Low-order conceptual models, which reduce a system to a few physically meaningful variables and their interactions (Figure 1 a) rather than simulating it in full detail, make such evaluation especially direct: competing hypotheses about the system can be written down as equations, compared, and tested [ 16 , 29 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 现有的基准测试通过单元测试或特定任务指标 [ 9 ]、基于已知解决方案或目标发现的标准评分表 [ 26 , 33 ]，或者语言模型评审员 [ 17 ]，对智能体的结果（无论是答案还是书面报告）进行评级。 开放式研究没有唯一正确的答案可供对照评分其结果。 动态建模是一种自然的研究测试环境：其中提出的模型会被模拟，并与观察结果进行验证。 低阶概念模型将系统简化为少数具有物理意义的变量及其相互作用（图 1a），而非完全详细地模拟系统，这使得评估尤为直接：关于该系统的竞争假设可以写成方程，进行比较和检验 [ 16 , 29 ]。

paragraphs.en: The El Niño–Southern Oscillation (ENSO) is a crucial application of such models. As the dominant mode of interannual climate variability, ENSO affects weather, agriculture, water resources, and marine ecosystems worldwide [ 19 ] . Its events recur irregularly, vary in strength and duration, and differ in whether warming peaks in the central or the eastern Pacific [ 5 , 28 ] . Although this behavior is hard to capture with a few variables, low-order models have advanced from the recharge oscillator [ 13 ] to recent stochastic models that reproduce much of ENSO’s diversity [ 8 , 34 ] and predict it competitively [ 35 ] . Yet which processes generate this complexity remains debated [ 30 , 28 , 29 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 厄尔尼诺-南方涛动（ENSO）是此类模型的一项重要应用。 作为年际气候变率的主要模式，ENSO影响着全球天气、农业、水资源和海洋生态系统 [ 19 ] 。 其事件发生不规律，强度和持续时间各不相同，且暖期峰值出现在太平洋中部还是东部也存在差异 [ 5 , 28 ] 。 尽管这种行为难以用少数变量捕捉，但低阶模型已从再充振子模型 [ 13 ] 发展到近期的随机模型，后者能够再现ENSO的大部分多样性 [ 8 , 34 ] ，并在预测上具有竞争力 [ 35 ] 。 然而，究竟是哪些过程产生了这种复杂性，仍存在争议 [ 30 , 28 , 29 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Turning ENSO modeling into a benchmark raises three challenges. First, the evaluation must establish whether a model is scientifically valid without a ground truth. Matching the observed statistics is not enough, because different dynamics can produce similar statistics. Second, the task must give agents enough structure to make progress without prescribing the scientific solution. Given only a broad goal, agents can stall in planning without producing a model, whereas supplying the governing equations would reduce the task to implementation. Third, agents need comprehensive feedback to improve their models over a long run. However, returning grader scores invites agents to exploit weaknesses in the grader [ 1 , 24 ] , and partial feedback leads them to neglect unmeasured aspects. Agents must therefore generate their own feedback.
paragraphs.zh: 将ENSO建模转化为基准测试会引发三个挑战。 首先，评估必须确定模型在缺乏真实数据的情况下是否具有科学有效性。 仅匹配观测到的统计数据是不够的，因为不同的动力学过程可能产生相似的统计数据。 其次，任务必须为智能体提供足够的结构，使其能够在不预设科学解决方案的前提下取得进展。 如果只给出一个宽泛的目标，智能体可能会在规划中停滞不前而无法生成模型；而若直接提供控制方程，则会将任务简化为单纯的实现过程。 第三，智能体需要全面的反馈，以便在长期运行中不断改进其模型。 然而，返回评分结果会促使智能体利用评分系统的弱点 [ 1 , 24 ] ，而部分反馈则会导致它们忽视未被测量的方面。 因此，智能体必须自行生成反馈。

paragraphs.en: We introduce SciExam for ENSO , a benchmark for long-horizon autonomous modeling of ENSO that addresses these challenges with three design choices. First, hidden graders evaluate each model on three complementary aspects: whether its free-running simulations reproduce ENSO’s observed statistics, whether it captures variable dependence, and whether it forecasts the held-out years better than persistence. This dependence is tested by reconstructing withheld variables from observed ones. The same graders score a published five-variable model [ 34 ] as a reference, and the first two tests follow the criteria that study used to validate it. Second, the task is divided into observation processing, diagnostic development, and model development, each with an explicit completion condition, within a shared six-hour budget. These stages fix what must be delivered but leave every scientific decision to the agent. Third, agents generate their own feedback by developing diagnostics from the task’s scientific guidance. The diagnostics are frozen before model development: agents may execute them to assess each revision but cannot modify them, which prevents their evaluation criteria from drifting toward their results. Grader scores and held-out data remain inaccessible throughout the run.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了用于ENSO的SciExam，这是一个面向ENSO长期自主建模的基准测试，通过三种设计选择来应对这些挑战。 首先，隐藏评分器从三个互补方面评估每个模型：其自由运行模拟能否复现ENSO的观测统计特征、能否捕捉变量间的依赖关系，以及其对保留年份的预测是否优于持续性方法。 这种依赖关系通过利用观测变量重建被保留的变量来检验。 相同的评分器还将一个已发表的包含五个变量的模型[34]作为参考进行评分，而前两项测试则遵循该研究用于验证此模型的准则。 其次，任务被划分为观测处理、诊断开发和模型开发三个阶段，每个阶段都有明确的完成条件，且总时间限制为六小时。 这些阶段明确了必须交付的内容，但所有科学决策都由智能体自行决定。 第三，智能体通过基于任务的科学指导开发诊断工具，从而生成自己的反馈信息。 这些诊断工具在模型开发前即已固定：智能体可以执行它们来评估每次修订，但不能修改它们，这能防止其评估标准向自身结果偏移。 在整个运行过程中，评分器的得分和保留数据均无法访问。

paragraphs.en: Six of twelve agent systems produce final models that score higher than the reference model (Figure 1 b), and three more come close. Their advantage lies in reconstruction and forecasting: the reference still reproduces ENSO’s statistics best, whereas most agent-built models reconstruct withheld variables and forecast the held-out years more skillfully. Beyond their scores, the models reflect a long-standing scientific debate. ENSO’s warm–cold asymmetry has two competing explanations [ 18 , 25 , 29 ] , and although the task mentions neither, each model approaching or exceeding the reference can be reduced to a form compatible with one of them. The models thus offer candidate mechanisms rather than mere fits to the data. The shared evaluation also reveals where the two explanations cannot yet be distinguished.

paragraphs.en: A natural concern is that agents succeed by recalling the observed record rather than modeling it. paragraphs.en: Long-horizon agent benchmarks test sustained work on software, machine-learning engineering, and optimization tasks [ 27 , 6 , 32 , 11 , 36 ] . Their tasks rarely involve a physical system, and they either grade against a known answer or, when none exists, as in ALE-Bench and most RE-Bench tasks, show the agent its score during the run (Table 1 ). Benchmarks for scientific research agents do involve physical systems, asking agents to replicate papers, complete data-driven analyses, reproduce published findings, or rediscover known equations [ 26 , 9 , 33 , 23 ] , but each grades the result against a known answer. None tests a result with scientific criteria beyond agreement with a target. In SciExam for ENSO , agents build a model of a real physical system, in a task with no known answer, and hidden tests judge its statistics, coupling, and forecasts after the run. Appendix H discusses equation discovery and conceptual ENSO models.

paragraphs.en: SciExam for ENSO mirrors a research setting in which a scientist receives observations, background material, and a modeling objective, and must decide how to build and assess a model. paragraphs.en: Agents work through three phases that share a six-hour budget, as shown in Figure 2 . The phases follow the order in which a scientist would approach the problem, first preparing the data, then deciding how to judge a model, and finally building one. This structure fixes what must be delivered while leaving every scientific decision to the agent.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体按照三个阶段开展工作，这三个阶段共享六小时的时间预算，如圖 2 所示。 这些阶段的顺序与科学家处理问题时的步骤一致：首先准备数据，然后决定如何评估模型，最后构建模型。 这种结构明确了必须交付的成果，同时将所有科学决策的权力都交给了智能体。

paragraphs.en: In Phase A, agents process the raw observations into the five monthly indices, and modeling begins only after their indices match a correctly processed version. This gate keeps processing errors out of the model and ensures that all agents model the same data, so their scores are directly comparable.
paragraphs.zh: 在阶段 A 中，智能体将原始观测数据转化为五个月度指数，只有当这些指数与正确处理后的版本相匹配时，建模才会开始。 这一机制可防止处理错误进入模型，并确保所有智能体都基于相同的数据进行建模，从而使它们的得分可以直接比较。

paragraphs.en: In Phase B, agents write their own diagnostics, choosing which quantities to check and how, from instructions that state what the final model will be judged on but not how it is measured. The phase ends when the agent declares the diagnostics complete or after 90 minutes. Checks of their own let agents judge each revision without seeing the graders’ scores, which would invite tuning to the scores rather than to the science.
paragraphs.zh: 在 B 阶段，智能体会自行编写诊断程序，根据说明选择需要检查的量以及检查方式；这些说明指明了最终模型将依据什么标准进行评判，但并未说明具体的测量方法。 当智能体宣布诊断完成或经过 90 分钟后，该阶段即告结束。 通过自我检查，智能体可以在不查看评分者分数的情况下对每次修订进行判断，否则它们可能会为了分数而非科学本身而进行调整。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate twelve agent systems, each pairing a language model with an agent scaffold: Claude Code, Codex, and Antigravity for Claude, GPT, and Gemini models, respectively, and Claude Code connected to OpenRouter for the others (Appendix B ). Each system runs in its own offline container, and the harness saves a checkpoint every five minutes of eligible time, which excludes waits caused by the model provider. To encourage exploration, agents are told that their best saved submission counts, but systems are compared on their final checkpoints. Best checkpoints would score higher, with eight rather than six systems exceeding the reference (Appendix B ). Appendix A summarizes the task materials and Appendix D reports the cost of the runs.

paragraphs.en: Figure 3 shows how the model of each system develops during the run and how its final model scores. In panel (a), progress within a run is not monotonic, partly because agents keep exploring alternative model structures rather than only refining the best one found so far. Claude Opus 5 and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, for example, reach their highest scores late in the run but submit final models that score below those checkpoints. Six of the twelve final models exceed the composite score of the published reference model ( 0.378 0.378 ), led by Claude Fable 5.1 ( 0.515 0.515 ), Kimi K3 ( 0.479 0.479 ), and GPT-5.6-Sol ( 0.443 0.443 ), and three more score close to it, between 0.345 0.345 and 0.369 0.369 . Differences of about 0.01 0.01 , as among GPT-5.6-Sol, GPT-6 Astra, and Claude Opus 5, should not be read as a ranking. The reference still reproduces the observed statistics best ( 0.727 0.727 ), whereas most agent-built models score higher on dynamical consistency and predictive skill, on which the reference scores 0.323 0.323 and 0.157 0.157 . They do so even though the reference was developed with observations from all three test periods (Section 3.3 ). Agents thus build, from only 35 years of observations, models that rival a published one.

paragraphs.en: Which processes generate ENSO’s complexity remains debated. Conceptual theories differ in which ocean and atmosphere processes drive the oscillation and in whether ENSO is self-sustained or a damped mode excited by stochastic forcing [ 30 , 28 , 29 ] . A prominent open question concerns its asymmetry, as warm events in the eastern Pacific tend to be stronger than cold events and give sea surface temperature a positively skewed distribution. One explanation attributes this asymmetry to deterministic nonlinearity in the coupled dynamics, such as a nonlinear wind response to sea surface temperature [ 25 ] . Another attributes it to multiplicative noise, stochastic forcing whose amplitude depends on the state, with which even a linear model reproduces the observed asymmetry [ 18 ] . Both are physically plausible, and their relative contributions remain unresolved [ 3 , 29 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 哪些过程产生了ENSO的复杂性，这一问题仍存在争议。 概念性理论在哪些海洋和大气过程驱动该振荡，以及ENSO是自维持的还是由随机强迫激发的一种阻尼模式方面存在差异 [ 30 , 28 , 29 ] 。 一个重要的开放性问题涉及其不对称性，因为东太平洋的暖事件往往比冷事件更强，并使海表温度呈现正偏态分布。 一种解释将这种不对称性归因于耦合动力学中的确定性非线性，例如海表温度对风的非线性响应 [ 25 ] 。 另一种解释则将其归因于乘性噪声，即振幅取决于系统状态的随机强迫，在这种情况下，即使线性模型也能再现观测到的不对称性 [ 18 ] 。 这两种解释在物理上都是合理的，但它们的相对贡献仍未得到解决 [ 3 , 29 ] 。

paragraphs.en: The agent-built models offer an independent view of this question, since none of the agents was told of either explanation. Each final model, however, mixes the terms that drive its behavior with components added during development and never removed. To find which terms matter, groups of terms were removed from each final model after all runs had ended, the remaining coefficients were refitted, and the reduced model was rescored with the same graders. A reduction was kept only if it retained nearly all of the original scores and the asymmetry of the model’s temperature distribution (Appendix G ). The analysis covers the nine models that exceed or approach the reference and asks which explanation of the asymmetry each reduced model relies on.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体构建的模型为这个问题提供了独立的视角，因为没有任何一个智能体被告知过这两种解释中的任何一种。 然而，每个最终模型都将驱动其行为的术语与开发过程中添加且从未移除的组件混合在一起。 为了确定哪些术语至关重要，在所有运行结束后，从每个最终模型中移除了若干术语组，重新拟合了剩余的系数，并使用相同的评分员对简化后的模型进行了重新评分。 只有当简化后的模型几乎保留了原始的所有分数以及模型温度分布的不对称性时（附录 G），该简化方案才会被保留。 这项分析涵盖了九个超过或接近参考标准的模型，并探讨了每个简化模型依赖哪一种对不对称性的解释。

paragraphs.en: The simplified models divide in how they generate the asymmetry of ENSO (Figure 5 b). Claude Fable 5.1 loses all of its nonlinear drift terms and reduces to linear drift with multiplicative noise, while its score rises from 0.515 0.515 to 0.542 0.542 . GPT-6 Astra instead retains a nonlinear temperature feedback driven by additive noise, with its score rising from 0.442 0.442 to 0.462 0.462 . Across the nine models, the simplified forms fall into these two families, four with linear drift and multiplicative noise and five with nonlinear drift and additive noise, matching the two explanations of ENSO asymmetry (Figure 5 c). The agent-built models thus admit reduced forms compatible with both established explanations. Simplification costs the models little. None of the nine loses more than 0.014 0.014 , and statistical scores often rise at a small cost in dynamical consistency (Table 3 ), so many terms added during development contributed little. These gains should be read with caution, because the same graders selected the reductions. GPT-5.5 can be simplified into either family, and the two reductions score within 0.3 0.3 percentage points of each other ( 0.398 0.398 and 0.395 0.395 ), so the evaluation cannot tell which explanation its dynamics require. The same ambiguity keeps the question open in the literature.

paragraphs.en: Additional six-hour runs of Claude Fable 5.1, the highest-scoring system, tested where its performance came from, with full scores in Appendix F . Each run changed one condition of the formal offline run. The first stayed offline but replaced every calendar year in the data and task materials with a relative label. The other two allowed web access, first to both the literature and data sources and then to the literature only, with the publication describing the reference model blocked in both. Each condition was run once, so these comparisons describe one agent under controlled changes rather than effects estimated across repeated runs.
paragraphs.zh: 对得分最高的系统 Claude Fable 5.1 进行了额外的六小时运行测试，以探究其性能来源，完整分数见附录 F。 每次运行都改变了正式离线运行中的一个条件。 第一种情况保持离线状态，但将数据和任务材料中的每个公历年份替换为相对标签。 另外两种情况允许访问网络：首先同时访问文献和数据源，然后仅访问文献，而描述参考模型的出版物在这两种情况下均被屏蔽。 每种条件仅运行一次，因此这些比较描述的是一种智能体在受控变化下的表现，而非通过重复运行估算出的影响。

paragraphs.en: Language models may succeed by recalling test data from their training corpus rather than by solving the task, and ENSO observations and event histories are widely published. Such recall helps little here, because a model with a few dozen coefficients cannot store an observed record, and knowing when past events occurred does not yield coefficients that reproduce ENSO’s statistics, dynamics, and forecasts. When each run is scored under the calendar convention its agent stated, the anonymized run reaches a best score of 0.482 0.482 and a final score of 0.463 0.463 , compared with 0.531 0.531 and 0.515 0.515 in the formal run, and it still reproduces the main statistical features of ENSO. A competitive model can therefore be built without knowing which years were observed.

paragraphs.en: More information did not always help. With data sources available, the agent adopted the event list of an operational ENSO index as its calibration target in place of the task data and reached the lowest best score of the four conditions ( 0.475 0.475 ), so data sources were excluded from the next run. With the literature only, the agent reached a best score of 0.528 0.528 , close to the offline 0.531 0.531 , but built its model differently. The offline and literature-only agents both began with a process-based recharge oscillator. The offline agent abandoned it after its first hand-set calibration proved unstable and fitted a dense linear matrix with all twenty-five couplings. The web agent kept the process structure and included only couplings with a physical pathway, whose signs match ENSO theory, including the recharge cycle and the Bjerknes feedback. This sparser model scores higher on statistics ( 0.798 0.798 versus 0.741 0.741 ) and lower on dynamical consistency ( 0.556 0.556 versus 0.632 0.632 ), the same trade-off that simplification shows in Section 5.1 . Its simplified core is closest to the linear family. All explicit nonlinear corrections can be removed without loss except a cubic damping added for stability, whereas replacing multiplicative with additive noise costs 12 % 12\% of the composite score, about twice the 6 % 6\% lost by removing the damping. Both web runs ended well below their best checkpoints, with final scores of 0.386 0.386 and 0.406 0.406 , a much larger decline than offline.
paragraphs.zh: 更多信息并不总能带来帮助。 在有数据源可用的情况下，智能体将运行中的ENSO指数的事件列表作为校准目标，取代任务数据，并达到了四种条件下最低的最好分数（0.475 0.475），因此在下一次运行中排除了数据源。 仅使用文献资料时，智能体达到了0.528 0.528的最好分数，接近离线状态的0.531 0.531，但其构建模型的方式有所不同。 离线智能体和仅使用文献资料的智能体都以基于过程的再充振荡器作为起点。 离线智能体在首次手动设定的校准证明不稳定后放弃了该结构，转而拟合了一个包含全部二十五种耦合的密集线性矩阵。 网络智能体保留了过程结构，但仅包含了具有物理路径的耦合，这些耦合的符号与ENSO理论一致，包括再充循环和比约克内斯反馈。 这个更稀疏的模型在统计指标上得分更高（0.798 0.798 对比 0.741 0.741），但在动力学一致性上得分更低（0.556 0.556 对比 0.632 0.632），这与第5.1节中简化模型所表现出的权衡一致。 其简化的核心最接近线性模型家族。 除了为稳定性而添加的三次阻尼外，所有显式的非线性修正都可以移除而不损失性能；而将乘法噪声替换为加法噪声则会损失复合分数的12%（12\%），大约是移除阻尼所损失的6%（6\%）的两倍。 两次网络运行最终得分均远低于其最佳检查点，分别为0.386 0.386和0.406 0.406，这一降幅远大于离线智能体的情况。

sents.en: With the literature only, the agent reached a best score of 0.528 0.528 , close to the offline 0.531 0.531 , but built its model differently.
sents.zh: 仅使用文献资料时，智能体达到了0.528 0.528的最好分数，接近离线状态的0.531 0.531，但其构建模型的方式有所不同。

sents.en: The offline and literature-only agents both began with a process-based recharge oscillator.
sents.zh: 离线智能体和仅使用文献资料的智能体都以基于过程的再充振荡器作为起点。

sents.en: The offline agent abandoned it after its first hand-set calibration proved unstable and fitted a dense linear matrix with all twenty-five couplings.
sents.zh: 离线智能体在首次手动设定的校准证明不稳定后放弃了该结构，转而拟合了一个包含全部二十五种耦合的密集线性矩阵。

sents.en: The web agent kept the process structure and included only couplings with a physical pathway, whose signs match ENSO theory, including the recharge cycle and the Bjerknes feedback.
sents.zh: 网络智能体保留了过程结构，但仅包含了具有物理路径的耦合，这些耦合的符号与ENSO理论一致，包括再充循环和比约克内斯反馈。

sents.en: This sparser model scores higher on statistics ( 0.798 0.798 versus 0.741 0.741 ) and lower on dynamical consistency ( 0.556 0.556 versus 0.632 0.632 ), the same trade-off that simplification shows in Section 5.1 .
sents.zh: 这个更稀疏的模型在统计指标上得分更高（0.798 0.798 对比 0.741 0.741），但在动力学一致性上得分更低（0.556 0.556 对比 0.632 0.632），这与第5.1节中简化模型所表现出的权衡一致。

sents.en: Its simplified core is closest to the linear family.
sents.zh: 其简化的核心最接近线性模型家族。

sents.en: All explicit nonlinear corrections can be removed without loss except a cubic damping added for stability, whereas replacing multiplicative with additive noise costs 12 % 12\% of the composite score, about twice the 6 % 6\% lost by removing the damping.
sents.zh: 除了为稳定性而添加的三次阻尼外，所有显式的非线性修正都可以移除而不损失性能；而将乘法噪声替换为加法噪声则会损失复合分数的12%（12\%），大约是移除阻尼所损失的6%（6\%）的两倍。

sents.en: Both web runs ended well below their best checkpoints, with final scores of 0.386 0.386 and 0.406 0.406 , a much larger decline than offline.
sents.zh: 两次网络运行最终得分均远低于其最佳检查点，分别为0.386 0.386和0.406 0.406，这一降幅远大于离线智能体的情况。

paragraphs.en: SciExam for ENSO evaluates agents that develop stochastic ENSO models from real observations, using hidden, independent scientific tests that require no known answer. Under these tests, six of twelve agent systems exceed a published reference model, and the simplified forms of the stronger models are each compatible with one of the two debated explanations of ENSO asymmetry. Agents can therefore already contribute candidate models to open scientific questions.
paragraphs.zh: SciExam for ENSO 评估那些基于真实观测数据构建随机 ENSO 模型的智能体，其过程采用隐藏且独立的科学测试，而这些测试无需已知答案。 在这些测试中，十二个智能体系统中有六个超越了已发表的参考模型，而更强模型中的简化形式分别与 ENSO 非对称性的两种争议性解释之一相符。 因此，智能体已经可以为开放的科学问题提供候选模型。

paragraphs.en: Agents receive raw gridded observations from January 1980 to December 2014, namely sea surface temperature from ERSSTv5 [ 10 ] , ocean potential temperature and zonal currents from GODAS [ 2 ] , and 850 hPa zonal wind from the NCEP–NCAR reanalysis [ 14 ] . A prescribed procedure, summarized below, specifies how to build the five monthly anomaly indices from these fields, and observations from 2015 onward are withheld. As background, agents receive the recharge-oscillator paper of Jin [13] , which links eastern Pacific sea surface temperature and western Pacific thermocline depth in a two-variable model with linear dynamics and simple nonlinear and stochastic extensions. They also receive characteristic scales for nondimensionalizing the indices.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体接收从 1980 年 1 月到 2014 年 12 月的原始网格化观测数据，即来自 ERSSTv5 [ 10 ] 的海面温度、来自 GODAS [ 2 ] 的海洋势温度和经向流，以及来自 NCEP–NCAR 再分析数据的 850 hPa 经向风 [ 14 ]。 下文总结了既定流程，该流程规定了如何基于这些场构建五个月度异常指数，而 2015 年及之后的观测数据则被保留不用。 作为背景知识，智能体接收 Jin [13] 的“再充-振荡器”论文，该论文通过一个包含线性动力学以及简单非线性和随机扩展的双变量模型，将东太平洋海面温度与西太平洋温跃层深度联系起来。 它们还接收用于对指数进行无量纲化的特征尺度。

paragraphs.en: Within the general form of Eq. ( 1 ), agents decide the governing equations themselves, including how the variables interact and how nonlinearity, seasonal dependence, and stochastic forcing are represented. Each submission is an executable implementation of Eq. ( 1 ) with its calibrated parameters, accompanied by a model card that describes the equations and the mechanisms they represent. The graders run this model to generate the simulations, reconstructions, and forecasts on which it is scored.
paragraphs.zh: 在方程（1）的一般形式中，智能体自行决定控制方程，包括变量之间的相互作用方式，以及非线性、季节性依赖和随机强迫的表达方式。每一份提交内容都是方程（1）的一个可执行实现，其中包含已校准的参数，并附有一张模型卡，用于描述这些方程及其所代表的机制。评分系统会运行该模型，以生成用于评分的模拟结果、重建结果和预测结果。

paragraphs.en: The instruction file asks the agent to build a low-dimensional stochastic dynamical model of ENSO that represents both central and eastern Pacific variability, reproduces the observed behavior of the tropical Pacific, and produces skillful forecasts. It describes a data-processing stage whose output must pass a check before modeling is unlocked, and a modeling stage in which the agent chooses the equations, nondimensionalizes the indices with the provided scales, calibrates the parameters, and compares the model with statistics computed from its own processed data. It names the scoring categories, namely the statistics of the simulated climate, the physical mechanism, forecast skill relative to persistence on initialization months the agent never sees, and a validity gate under which an unstable or non-finite model scores zero, without giving thresholds, weights, or held-out data. It also states the rules. The agent must build the model itself, must not use publications that already contain a complete calibrated model of this system, and must stay inside its working directory without accessing any grader, reference model, or observation file outside it.
paragraphs.zh: 该指令文件要求智能体构建一个低维随机动力模型，用于模拟ENSO，该模型需同时反映中太平洋和东太平洋的变异性，重现热带太平洋的观测行为，并生成具有预测能力的预报结果。 它描述了一个数据处理阶段，其输出必须通过检查才能解锁建模过程；随后是一个建模阶段，智能体在此阶段选择方程、使用提供的标度对指标进行无量纲化、校准参数，并将模型与基于自身处理数据计算出的统计数据进行比较。 它列出了评分类别，即模拟气候的统计数据、物理机制、在智能体从未见过的初始化月份中相对于持续预测法的预报能力，以及一个有效性检验：若模型不稳定或无界，则得分为零；但并未给出阈值、权重或预留测试数据。 它还说明了相关规则。 智能体必须自行构建模型，不得使用已包含该系统完整校准模型的出版物，且必须限定在其工作目录内，不得访问任何评分器、参考模型或目录外的观测文件。

paragraphs.en: The processing file prescribes a fixed recipe, and all regional averages are weighted by the cosine of latitude over boxes between 5 ∘ 5^{\circ} S and 5 ∘ 5^{\circ} N. T C T_{C} and T E T_{E} are sea surface temperature averages over the Niño 4 box, from 160 ∘ 160^{\circ} E to 150 ∘ 150^{\circ} W, and the Niño 3 box, from 150 ∘ 150^{\circ} W to 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} W. h W h_{W} is the depth of the 20 ∘ 20^{\circ} C isotherm averaged from 120 ∘ 120^{\circ} E to 180 ∘ 180^{\circ} , where the depth in each water column is found by linear interpolation between the two GODAS levels that bracket the first crossing from the surface. u u is the zonal current averaged over the levels from the surface to 55 55 m and over the Niño 4 box. τ \tau is the 850 850 hPa zonal wind averaged from 120 ∘ 120^{\circ} E to 180 ∘ 180^{\circ} , first over the box for each day and then over each month, with westerly winds positive. Anomalies are formed by removing the monthly climatology of 1981 to 2010 from every index, without detrending. The file also lists common pitfalls, such as fill values, land masks, longitudes across the dateline, and GODAS temperatures given in Kelvin. The data check compares each index element-wise with a reference processed in the same way, within a tight tolerance. When the check fails, the feedback names the indices that differ and the month of the largest discrepancy.
paragraphs.zh: 处理文件规定了一个固定的配方，所有区域平均值均根据南纬5°（5 ∘ 5^{\circ} S）与北纬5°（5 ∘ 5^{\circ} N）之间的各网格盒中纬度余弦值进行加权。 T C T_{C} 和 T E T_{E} 分别是Niño 4区域（东经160°（160 ∘ 160^{\circ} E）至西经150°（150 ∘ 150^{\circ} W））和Niño 3区域（西经150°（150 ∘ 150^{\circ} W）至西经90°（90 ∘ 90^{\circ} W））的海面温度平均值。h W h_{W} 是20°C（20 ∘ 20^{\circ} C）等温线的深度，该值从东经120°（120 ∘ 120^{\circ} E）至180°（180 ∘ 180^{\circ} ）的平均计算得出，其中每个水柱的深度通过线性插值法确定，插值点为GODAS数据中首次穿越海面的两个相邻层级。u u 是从海面至55米（55 m）深度、并在Niño 4区域上平均得到的环流带流速。τ \tau 是850 hPa高度上的环流带风速，从东经120°（120 ∘ 120^{\circ} E）至180°（180 ∘ 180^{\circ} ）的平均值，先按每日计算各网格盒内的值，再按月平均，其中西风为正。 异常值是通过从每个指数中减去1981年至2010年的月度气候学平均值而得到的，且未进行去趋势处理。 该文件还列出了常见的陷阱，例如填充值、陆地掩膜、跨越日期变更线的经度，以及以开尔文为单位的GODAS温度数据。 数据检查将每个指数与采用相同方式处理的参考数据逐元素进行比较，并设定严格的容差范围。 当检查失败时，反馈信息会指出存在差异的指数以及差异最大的月份。

paragraphs.en: The interface file fixes the form of the submission. The submitted model exposes a single time-stepping function, which advances an ensemble of five-variable states, given in physical units, by one stochastic step of a given length in months at a given model time, drawing all random numbers from a generator supplied by the graders. The graders build every experiment on this function, namely free simulations from the zero state, ensemble forecasts initialized from the observed indices, and an ensemble Kalman smoother that observes some variables and reconstructs the others, which the file describes as a test of the dependence among variables. A submission whose model fails to import, raises an error, or returns non-finite values fails the validity gate. The calibrated parameters are stored in a separate parameter file, and the model card describes the state variables, equations, and mechanisms.
paragraphs.zh: 接口文件规定了提交内容的形式。 提交的模型仅暴露一个时间步长推进函数，该函数以物理单位给出的五个变量状态集合为基础，在指定的模型时间点上，按指定长度（以月为单位）推进一个随机步长，所有随机数均从评分者提供的生成器中抽取。 评分者基于此函数构建所有实验，包括从零状态开始的自由模拟、由观测指标初始化的集合预报，以及一个通过观测部分变量并重构其余变量的集合卡尔曼平滑器；文件将其描述为对变量间依赖关系的测试。 若模型无法导入、引发错误或返回非有限值，则提交内容将未能通过有效性检查。 校准参数存储在一个独立的参数文件中，而模型卡片则描述了状态变量、方程和机制。

paragraphs.en: The harness sends one prompt at the start of each phase. The Phase A prompt asks the agent to process the raw data into the five indices by following the processing file, and a failed check returns the prompt with the feedback, for up to four attempts. The Phase B prompt tells the agent that nothing in its workspace will score its model and asks it to write diagnostic scripts that run the submitted model and report how far it is from the observations. It asks each script to report the quantity, the observed value, and the gap rather than a pass or fail verdict, and to state the discrepancy it finds. It warns that the diagnostics become read-only once the agent stops, and it describes the three evaluation dimensions in one sentence each, as whether a long free run looks like the observed climate, whether the model behaves as a coupled dynamical system, and whether it forecasts better than persistence from an observed initial state, adding that these are descriptions rather than metrics. If a script fails to run, a repair prompt asks the agent to fix or delete it before the diagnostics are frozen. The Phase C prompt asks for the three submission files, states that the diagnostics are now read-only and that no new evaluation code should be written, warns that agreement between the checks and the observations does not mean the model is finished, and repeats the three descriptions. To encourage exploration, it also explains that the submission is copied automatically and that the best copy counts, so that a failed experiment cannot lower the grade. It further notes that running simulations consumes the same time budget and that the agent should keep working for the whole budget.
paragraphs.zh: 每个阶段开始时，约束系统都会发送一条提示。 A 阶段的提示要求智能体按照处理文件将原始数据加工成五个指标；如果检查失败，则会返回包含反馈信息的提示，最多允许四次尝试。 B 阶段的提示告知智能体，其工作区中的任何内容都不会用于评估模型，并要求其编写诊断脚本，运行已提交的模型，并报告其与观测结果之间的差距。 该提示要求每个脚本报告数量、观测值以及差距，而不是给出通过或失败的判定，并说明其发现的差异。 该提示警告称，一旦智能体停止运行，诊断信息将变为只读；同时用一句话分别描述了三个评估维度：长期自由运行是否类似于观测到的气候、模型是否表现为耦合的动力学系统，以及从观测到的初始状态出发，其预测是否优于持续性预测，并补充说明这些是描述而非指标。 如果某个脚本无法运行，修复提示会要求智能体在诊断信息被锁定前修复或删除该脚本。 C 阶段的提示要求提供三个提交文件，指出此时诊断信息已变为只读且不应再编写新的评估代码；同时警告称，检查结果与观测结果一致并不意味着模型已完成，并重复了上述三个描述。 为了鼓励探索，该提示还说明提交内容会被自动复制，且最佳版本将被采用，因此失败的实验不会导致评分降低。 此外，该提示指出运行模拟会消耗相同的时间配额，智能体应在全配额时间内持续工作。

paragraphs.en: Later turns of Phase C use a resume prompt that restates these points. After 20, 40, and 60 minutes without a new copy of the submission, escalating prompts ask the agent to run its diagnostics, find its weakest aspect, and change the model, and to reconsider its structure if parameter tuning is exhausted. In Claude Code, a stop hook blocks a voluntary exit with a short reminder to check the model on the three dimensions, until the submission has stayed unchanged over three stop attempts, and the Gemini scaffold receives the same reminder through its continuation loop. paragraphs.en: Each evaluated system pairs a language model with an agent scaffold, the software through which the model reads files, runs code, and manages its own work. Because the scaffold shapes how a model works over a long run, the benchmark compares complete systems rather than models alone. Claude, GPT, and Gemini models run in the scaffolds their developers provide for agentic work, namely Claude Code, Codex, and Antigravity, each through its subscription service, while the remaining models run in Claude Code connected to OpenRouter through a LiteLLM gateway. Each system runs at the settings of its service: medium reasoning effort for subscription systems and the provider default for the rest, so differences between systems reflect the model together with its scaffold and settings rather than the model alone.
paragraphs.zh: 每个经过评估的系统都将一个语言模型与一个智能体框架配对，该框架是模型读取文件、运行代码和管理自身工作的软件。 由于框架决定了模型在长期运行中的工作方式，因此该基准测试比较的是完整的系统，而非单独的模型。 Claude、GPT 和 Gemini 模型在其开发者为智能体工作提供的框架中运行，即 Claude Code、Codex 和 Antigravity，每个框架都通过其订阅服务提供；而其他模型则在通过 LiteLLM 网关连接到 OpenRouter 的 Claude Code 中运行。 每个系统都按照其服务的设置运行：订阅系统使用中等推理强度，其余系统则使用提供商的默认设置，因此系统之间的差异反映了模型与其框架及设置的共同作用，而非仅由模型本身决定。

paragraphs.en: Each run has a six-hour budget of eligible time shared across the three phases. This is long enough for every system to finish while keeping full runs of twelve systems practical. paragraphs.zh: 每次运行共有六小时的可用时间预算，该预算由三个阶段共享。 这个时长足以让每个系统完成运行，同时也能确保十二个系统的完整运行具备可行性。 遵循早期的长期基准测试 [ 32 , 26 ]，可用时间不包括因模型提供商造成的等待时间，即使用配额耗尽和临时服务故障，从而确保所有系统都在相同的工作时间内进行比较。

paragraphs.en: Each system is run once. The object of evaluation is the model that each run produces, which is scored and inspected as a scientific result in its own right, so the comparisons describe these models rather than the expected performance of each system. During model development, the harness copies the submission every five minutes of eligible time, at the end of every agent turn, and once more when the run ends, and each copy that differs from all earlier copies is kept as a checkpoint. All checkpoints are scored after the run, which shows how the model develops over time. The prompts tell the agent that its best copy counts, which is intended to let it explore without protecting a working version. The main comparison nonetheless uses the final checkpoint, so it differs from the objective stated to the agent. The best checkpoint can only be identified by scoring all checkpoints with the hidden graders, which selects on the test metric itself and is not something the agent can do. The final checkpoint is the model the agent had at the end of its budget, and because the best checkpoint always scores at least as high, this choice can only understate each run. Table 4 reports both for every system.

During model development, the harness credits a pause when the provider reports an exhausted quota with a stated reset time, for the stated delay and for at most 12 12 such events, or reports a transient service failure, for at most 600 600 s per event. A rate-limit error without a stated reset is not credited and consumes eligible time. Credited pauses are capped at six hours in total, and the wall time of a run is capped at 18 18 hours. Phase A allows at most four attempts at the data check, each limited to 30 30 minutes, and a run that fails all four ends there. Phase B ends when the agent ends its turn, and at the latest after 90 90 minutes, followed by at most two repair rounds for scripts that fail to run. The diagnostics are then made read-only. In Phase C, the harness resumes the agent session whenever a turn ends, using the stall prompts of Appendix A after 20 20 , 40 40 , and 60 60 minutes without a new checkpoint. A run ends early if an agent turn exits within 5 5 s, if three consecutive turns fail, or if eight consecutive turns end in an error despite changing the submission.

paragraphs.en: ENSO is irregular, and its events differ in timing, strength, duration, and location. A stochastic model cannot, and is not expected to, reproduce the particular sequence of events in the observed record. What it should reproduce is the statistical behavior of ENSO, so we compare statistics of long simulations with those of the observations, choosing features that climate scientists use to characterize ENSO. The probability density function (PDF) of each temperature index measures the amplitude of variability and its asymmetry. Observed anomalies are positively skewed in the eastern Pacific, where the strongest El Niño events occur, and negatively skewed in the central Pacific. The seasonal variance, computed separately for each calendar month, measures how ENSO is locked to the annual cycle. Events tend to peak near the end of the calendar year, so the observed variance is largest in December and smallest in spring or early summer. The autocorrelation function (ACF) measures how long anomalies persist and how quickly they reverse. The observed ACF becomes negative at lags beyond about one year, reflecting the alternation between El Niño and La Niña. Event frequencies measure ENSO diversity. Eastern Pacific (EP) and central Pacific (CP) El Niño, extreme El Niño, La Niña, and multi-year events have different climate impacts, and a model with realistic variability can still produce the wrong mix of them. Finally, a bivariate diagnostic of event strength and location tests a nonlinear signature of diversity, namely that strong El Niño events peak farther east than moderate ones.
paragraphs.zh: ENSO 是不规则的，其事件在发生时间、强度、持续时间和位置上各不相同。 随机模型既无法重现观测记录中特定的事件序列，也不被期望做到这一点。 它应当重现的是 ENSO 的统计行为，因此我们将长期模拟的统计数据与观测数据进行比较，并选择气候科学家用来描述 ENSO 的特征。 每个温度指数的概率密度函数（PDF）衡量了变异的幅度及其不对称性。 观测到的异常在东太平洋呈正偏态分布，那里发生了最强的厄尔尼诺事件；而在中太平洋则呈负偏态分布。 季节性方差按每个日历月单独计算，用于衡量 ENSO 与年度周期的锁定程度。 事件通常在年末附近达到峰值，因此观测到的方差在十二月最大，在春季或初夏最小。 自相关函数（ACF）衡量了异常持续的时间以及其反转的速度。 观测到的自相关函数在滞后时间超过一年左右时变为负值，反映了厄尔尼诺和拉尼娜之间的交替出现。 事件频率用于衡量 ENSO 的多样性。 东太平洋（EP）和中太平洋（CP）的厄尔尼诺、极端厄尔尼诺、拉尼娜以及多年期事件具有不同的气候影响，而一个具备真实变异的模型仍可能产生错误的事件组合。 最后，一种对事件强度和位置的双变量诊断方法可以检验多样性的非线性特征，即强厄尔尼诺事件的峰值位置比中等强度的事件更偏东。

sents.en: The observed ACF becomes negative at lags beyond about one year, reflecting the alternation between El Niño and La Niña.
sents.zh: 观测到的自相关函数在滞后时间超过一年左右时变为负值，反映了厄尔尼诺和拉尼娜之间的交替出现。

sents.en: Event frequencies measure ENSO diversity.
sents.zh: 事件频率用于衡量 ENSO 的多样性。

sents.en: Eastern Pacific (EP) and central Pacific (CP) El Niño, extreme El Niño, La Niña, and multi-year events have different climate impacts, and a model with realistic variability can still produce the wrong mix of them.
sents.zh: 东太平洋（EP）和中太平洋（CP）的厄尔尼诺、极端厄尔尼诺、拉尼娜以及多年期事件具有不同的气候影响，而一个具备真实变异的模型仍可能产生错误的事件组合。

sents.en: Finally, a bivariate diagnostic of event strength and location tests a nonlinear signature of diversity, namely that strong El Niño events peak farther east than moderate ones.
sents.zh: 最后，一种对事件强度和位置的双变量诊断方法可以检验多样性的非线性特征，即强厄尔尼诺事件的峰值位置比中等强度的事件更偏东。

The monthly values of T C T_{C} and T E T_{E} from the remaining 2100 years are divided into 30 non-overlapping 70-year segments, each as long as the observed record. The observed record consists of the Niño 4 and Niño 3 sea surface temperature anomaly indices from 1950 to 2019 used by the reference study [ 34 ] , taken from the data record of Chen and Fang [7] and derived from HadISST1.1 [ 20 ] . The PDF, seasonal variance, and ACF are computed for every segment and averaged over the 30 segments, which removes most of the sampling noise of a single 70-year record while keeping each statistic comparable with the observed one. In Figure 4 , the simulated curves show this segment average, and the shading around them shows one standard deviation across the 30 segments. Events are counted in 71-year segments and compared with the observed counts per 71 years reported by the reference study, using the same definitions. Each winter is classified from its December to February means of T E T_{E} and T C T_{C} . It is an El Niño if either mean exceeds 0.5 ∘ 0.5\,^{\circ} C, of EP type if T E T_{E} is the larger and of CP type otherwise, and a La Niña if either mean falls below − 0.5 ∘ -0.5\,^{\circ} C. paragraphs.en: The minimum term prevents a model that fails one feature of ENSO from compensating with the others.
paragraphs.zh: 最短期限的设置可以防止模型因未能满足ENSO的一项特征而通过其他特征进行补偿。

paragraphs.en: Reproducing observed statistics does not establish that a model captures how its variables interact, because different dynamics can produce similar statistics. ENSO arises from coupling between the ocean and the atmosphere. Eastern Pacific warming weakens the trade winds, and the weaker winds drive eastward current anomalies and flatten the thermocline, and these changes in turn reinforce the warming. The slow recharge and discharge of equatorial heat content, represented by h W h_{W} , sets the timing of transitions between El Niño and La Niña. If a model represents these couplings correctly, observing some variables should reveal much about the others. We test this with data assimilation, the standard method for combining a model with incomplete observations. In Bayesian terms, the model provides a prior distribution of states, measurements of some variables update it to a posterior distribution, and the posterior mean of the unmeasured variables is their reconstruction. Because the unmeasured variables are informed only through the relationships encoded in the model, an accurate reconstruction is evidence that these relationships are realistic.
paragraphs.zh: 复现观测到的统计数据并不能证明模型捕捉到了其变量之间的相互作用方式，因为不同的动态过程也可能产生相似的统计数据。 ENSO源于海洋与大气之间的耦合。 东太平洋的变暖会削弱信风，而风力减弱会引发向东的流异常并使温跃层变平，这些变化反过来又会加剧变暖。 赤道热量含量的缓慢充放电过程（由 h W h_{W} 表示）决定了厄尔尼诺与拉尼娜之间转换的时间节点。 如果模型能正确表示这些耦合关系，那么观测某些变量应该能够揭示许多关于其他变量的信息。 我们通过数据同化方法来检验这一点，这是将模型与不完整观测数据相结合的标准方法。 从贝叶斯的角度来看，模型提供了状态的先验分布，对部分变量的测量会将其更新为后验分布，而未测量变量的后验均值即为这些变量的重建结果。 由于未测量的变量仅通过模型中编码的关系获得信息，因此准确的重建结果表明这些关系是符合实际的。

paragraphs.en: The graders use the observed monthly indices from 1980 to 2014, the period available to the agents. An ensemble of 500 model states is advanced month by month by the submitted model, each member with its own stochastic forcing, so that the spread of the ensemble and the correlations among its variables reflect the model’s own uncertainty and coupling. At the end of each month, an ensemble Kalman smoother assimilates the observed values of the conditioning variables, adjusting every member toward the observations in proportion to the covariances within the ensemble. The smoother also revises the states of the preceding three months with each new observation, so the reconstruction depends on the lagged relationships in the model, such as the lead of the western Pacific thermocline over eastern Pacific temperature, and not only on simultaneous ones. The ensemble mean of each unobserved variable is its reconstruction. The actual records of these variables are withheld from the smoother and used only for scoring. In test A, T C T_{C} and T E T_{E} are assimilated to reconstruct h W h_{W} , u u , and τ \tau . In test B, the roles are reversed, so the coupling is tested in both directions.

sents.en: The smoother also revises the states of the preceding three months with each new observation, so the reconstruction depends on the lagged relationships in the model, such as the lead of the western Pacific thermocline over eastern Pacific temperature, and not only on simultaneous ones.
sents.zh: 每次获得新的观测值时，平滑器还会修正前三个月的状态，因此重建不仅依赖于同时刻的关系，还依赖于模型中的滞后关系，例如西太平洋温跃层对东太平洋温度的领先作用。

sents.en: The ensemble mean of each unobserved variable is its reconstruction.
sents.zh: 每个未观测变量的集合均值即为其重建值。

sents.en: The actual records of these variables are withheld from the smoother and used only for scoring.
sents.zh: 这些变量的实际记录并未输入平滑器，仅用于评分。

paragraphs.en: Forecasting is a primary practical use of ENSO models, and it is the only test on data that the agents never saw. The held-out period from 2015 to 2024 includes the extreme El Niño of 2015/16, the multi-year La Niña from 2020 to 2023, and the El Niño of 2023/24, so it covers strong events, a multi-year event, and rapid transitions. Forecasts are compared with persistence, which assumes that the current anomaly continues unchanged. Persistence predicts no change, so a model that cannot improve on it has no forecast skill, and improving on it requires the model to capture how anomalies grow, decay, and reverse.
paragraphs.zh: 预测是ENSO模型的主要实际应用，也是智能体从未见过的唯一数据测试。 从2015年到2024年的保留时段包含了2015/16年的极端厄尔尼诺事件、2020年至2023年的多年拉尼娜事件以及2023/24年的厄尔尼诺事件，因此涵盖了强事件、多年事件和快速转换。 预测结果与持续性预测进行比较，后者假设当前的异常状态保持不变。 持续性预测认为不会有任何变化，因此无法超越它的模型不具备任何预测能力；要超越它，模型必须能够捕捉到异常状态如何增长、衰减和反转。

paragraphs.en: Groups of terms were removed from each final model, the remaining coefficients were refitted to long simulations of the original model, and the reduced model was rescored with the same graders and random seed. A reduction was kept if it retained at least 95 % 95\% of the original composite score and 90 % 90\% of every dimension score, and if it kept the model’s ENSO complexity, in particular the asymmetry of its temperature distribution, which the scores alone can miss. For GPT-6 Astra and the two DeepSeek models, removing both nonlinear drift and multiplicative noise keeps the scores within these limits but leaves a nearly symmetric distribution and lower event diversity, so removal stopped before the asymmetry was lost. paragraphs.en: Data-driven methods identify governing equations by sparse regression over candidate terms [ 4 ] or by symbolic regression [ 21 ] , and language models now propose equation skeletons that are fitted and scored against data [ 22 , 23 ] . These methods work on prepared data within a fixed pipeline, whereas agents in SciExam for ENSO process raw observations, choose what to check, and are judged on behavior that a good fit does not guarantee. Machine-learning emulators of climate have their own benchmarks [ 31 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 数据驱动方法通过候选项的稀疏回归 [4] 或符号回归 [21] 来识别控制方程，而语言模型现在会提出方程骨架，并依据数据对其进行拟合与评分 [22, 23]。 这些方法在固定流程中处理已准备好的数据，而 SciExam 中用于 ENSO 的智能体则能处理原始观测数据、选择需要检查的内容，并且其表现评估标准并非良好拟合所能保证的。 气候系统的机器学习模拟器也有其自身的基准 [31]。

paragraphs.en: Low-order ENSO models range from the recharge oscillator [ 13 ] to stochastic multiscale models of ENSO diversity [ 8 ] , an extended recharge oscillator that forecasts competitively [ 35 ] , and an automated framework that builds stochastic models of ENSO diversity by selecting their terms with causal inference [ 34 ] . That study validated its models by their statistics, their event diversity, and their recovery of unobserved variables through data assimilation. SciExam for ENSO adopts these criteria for its first two dimensions and adds forecasts of held-out years. Its contribution lies in the workflow around these tests, in which general-purpose agents process raw observations, write and freeze their own diagnostics, and develop a model over hours without seeing any score. Whether ENSO asymmetry arises from nonlinear dynamics or multiplicative noise remains debated [ 18 , 25 , 29 ] . The agent-built models of this study add candidates to the asymmetry debate under common tests.
paragraphs.zh: 低阶ENSO模型涵盖了从再充振子模型 [ 13 ] 到ENSO多样性的随机多尺度模型 [ 8 ]，还包括一种具有竞争力的预测能力的扩展再充振子模型 [ 35 ]，以及一个通过因果推断选择术语来构建ENSO多样性随机模型的自动化框架 [ 34 ]。 该研究通过统计指标、事件多样性以及利用数据同化恢复未观测变量来验证其模型。 SciExam for ENSO在其前两个维度上采用了这些标准，并增加了针对预留年份的预测。 其贡献在于围绕这些测试构建的工作流程：通用智能体处理原始观测数据，编写并固化自身的诊断指标，并在数小时内无需查看任何评分即可开发出一个模型。 ENSO不对称性究竟是源于非线性动力学还是乘性噪声，这一问题仍存在争议 [ 18 , 25 , 29 ]。 本研究由智能体构建的模型在通用测试下为这场关于不对称性的争论增添了新的候选方案。
